messages:
Alex Chen: Quick sync: debating rolling internal API surface from REST -> gRPC. I sketched a rollout playbook and want ops/console input. Main concerns: routing policy changes, quota propagation, telemetry, and canary UX.
Maria Gomez: Need a JSON->gRPC compatibility path for browsers/legacy SDKs. Envoy transcoding ok for simple shapes but we need a plan for complex payloads. Also preserve quota headers (X-Customer-Id, X-Quota-Key).
Raj Patel: For routing, propose sidecar for tenant-local fast path + gateway for cross-tenant and browser fallbacks. Canary sizes: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 50% with automated gates + manual override.
Oliver King: What metrics gate promotion? I propose p95 latency delta, error-rate delta, and increase in retry counts. Also track cold-start percentiles for new gRPC pools.
Frank Li: Add proto schema evolution CI: enforce backward & forward compat. Console should have a toggle for manual promote/rollback and show cohort size.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy at 1742233480. Ensure `canary_tag` and `proto-ci` checks are enabled.
Alex Chen: Telemetry: per-route dashboard with p50/p95, qps, errors, retries, and a new quota metric `quota_propagation_failures`. Also show sample traces for schema or unmarshal errors.
Maria Gomez: Quota semantics: pass both token counts and unit counts. If gateway can't validate quota, fallback to soft-limit policy with a `503` plus header `X-Quota-Partial` so clients can backoff.
Raj Patel: Gating thresholds: p95 increase <= 2% absolute, error rate increase <= 0.1% absolute, and zero `schema_unmarshal_error` in sampled traces for 10m. Those will be automated checks.
Oliver King: Console UX: show cohort % next to health (green/yellow/red), one-click rollback, links to example traces, and a diff view of request/response samples between REST & gRPC.
Frank Li: On replay for verification: thin gateway can replay traffic to both endpoints, but must avoid double-charging quota. Use header `X-Replay-Exempt: true` and require `X-Idempotency-Key`. Add metric `replay_ignored_count` to detect misuse.
Alex Chen: Action items: PR playbook with exact gate defs, console mockups, proto-ci addition, and a tiny POC shim using envoy + replay mode. I'll open the PR and tag reviewers. Thanks :rocket:
